intro.text: An advisor to King Nohadon: a one-armed man of letters who had once led a group of Surgebinders.

items.text: In one of his visions, Dalinar took Karm's place, and Nohadon talked with him casually as with a trusted friend.
When Dalinar brought Venli into the same vision, she took Karm's place, looking like a Parshendi, and Dalinar distracted Nohadon so the two of them could talk.
